lessons.title: A Journalist's Report
lessons.context: A news-style report using Konjunktiv I.

paragraphs.de: Die Journalistin schrieb, die Lage in der Stadt sei angespannt, aber unter Kontrolle.
paragraphs.en: The journalist wrote that the situation in the city was tense, but under control.

paragraphs.de: Ein Sprecher der Behörde erklärte, man arbeite bereits an einer Lösung.
paragraphs.en: A spokesperson for the authority explained that they were already working on a solution.

paragraphs.de: Zeugen berichteten, sie hätten den Vorfall selbst nicht direkt gesehen.
paragraphs.en: Witnesses reported that they had not seen the incident directly themselves.

paragraphs.de: Die Untersuchung des Falls werde, laut Polizei, noch mehrere Wochen dauern.
paragraphs.en: The investigation of the case, according to police, would take several more weeks.

paragraphs.de: Man rechne damit, dass die vollständigen Ergebnisse Ende des Monats veröffentlicht würden.
paragraphs.en: It was expected that the complete results would be published at the end of the month.

questions.question: How did the journalist describe the situation?
What did the authority spokesperson say?
options: They were already working on a solution

questions.question: What did witnesses say?
options: They hadn't seen the incident directly

questions.question: When are the full results expected?

lessons.title: If Things Had Been Different
lessons.titleNative: Wenn die Dinge anders gewesen wären
lessons.context: A reflective narrative in Konjunktiv II throughout.

paragraphs.de: Wenn sie den Job damals nicht angenommen hätte, wäre ihr Leben ganz anders verlaufen.
paragraphs.en: If she hadn't taken the job back then, her life would have turned out completely different.

paragraphs.de: Sie hätte vielleicht studiert, anstatt sofort zu arbeiten.
paragraphs.en: She might have studied, instead of working right away.

paragraphs.de: Hätte sie doch nur gewusst, wie sehr diese Entscheidung ihr ganzes Leben prägen würde!
paragraphs.en: If only she had known how much this decision would shape her whole life!

paragraphs.de: Dennoch bereut sie ihre Wahl nicht, denn sie hat viel dabei gelernt.
paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, she doesn't regret her choice, because she learned a lot from it.

paragraphs.de: Manchmal fragt sie sich, was gewesen wäre, wenn sie sich anders entschieden hätte, aber sie lässt sich davon nicht beunruhigen.
paragraphs.en: Sometimes she wonders what would have been if she had decided differently, but she doesn't let it worry her.

questions.question: What would have happened if she hadn't taken the job?
options: Her life would have turned out completely different

questions.question: What might she have done instead?
options: Studied instead of working right away

questions.question: Does she regret her choice?
How does she handle wondering 'what if'?
options: She doesn't let it worry her

lessons.title: Rules Worth Following
lessons.titleNative: Regeln, die es wert sind, befolgt zu werden
lessons.context: A short essay using passive alternatives.

paragraphs.de: Manche Regeln sind einfach zu befolgen, während andere sich kaum durchsetzen lassen.
paragraphs.en: Some rules are easy to follow, while others can hardly be enforced.

paragraphs.de: Zum Beispiel lässt sich die Regel 'sei pünktlich' leicht einhalten, wenn man sie ernst nimmt.
paragraphs.en: For example, the rule 'be punctual' can easily be followed if one takes it seriously.

paragraphs.de: Andere Regeln sind schwerer zu verstehen und daher schwerer zu befolgen.
paragraphs.en: Other rules are harder to understand and therefore harder to follow.

paragraphs.de: Man sollte Regeln erklären, anstatt sie einfach vorzuschreiben, damit sie akzeptiert werden.
paragraphs.en: One should explain rules, instead of simply prescribing them, so that they are accepted.

paragraphs.de: Nur so lassen sich Regeln entwickeln, die wirklich funktionieren.
paragraphs.en: Only this way can rules be developed that really work.

questions.question: What does the essay say about following rules?
options: Some are easy, others hard to enforce

questions.question: What example is given of an easy rule?
What should be done instead of just prescribing rules?
What is needed for rules to really work?

lessons.title: The Power of Small Words
lessons.context: A reflective text using modal particles naturally.

paragraphs.de: Manchmal sagt man 'komm doch mal vorbei', und das klingt viel freundlicher als eine einfache Einladung.
paragraphs.en: Sometimes you say 'do come by sometime', and that sounds much friendlier than a simple invitation.

paragraphs.de: Kleine Wörter wie 'doch', 'ja' und 'mal' verändern den Ton eines Satzes, ohne seine eigentliche Bedeutung zu ändern.
paragraphs.en: Small words like 'doch', 'ja', and 'mal' change the tone of a sentence without changing its actual meaning.

paragraphs.de: Ausländer, die Deutsch lernen, finden diese Wörter oft schwer zu verstehen, weil sie sich nicht direkt übersetzen lassen.
paragraphs.en: Foreigners learning German often find these words hard to understand because they can't be directly translated.

paragraphs.de: Trotzdem sind sie eben ein wichtiger Teil der gesprochenen Sprache.
paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, they are indeed an important part of the spoken language.

paragraphs.de: Wer sie versteht, klingt gleich viel natürlicher, wenn er Deutsch spricht.
paragraphs.en: Whoever understands them sounds much more natural right away when speaking German.

questions.question: What does 'komm doch mal vorbei' sound like compared to a plain invitation?
What do words like 'doch' and 'ja' change?
Why do foreigners find these words hard?
What happens when someone understands these words?

lessons.title: The Meeting Nobody Wanted
lessons.context: A workplace story combining connectors and nominalization.

paragraphs.de: Die Ankündigung des Meetings sorgte bei vielen Mitarbeitern für Unmut.
paragraphs.en: The announcement of the meeting caused displeasure among many employees.

paragraphs.de: Zwar verstanden alle die Notwendigkeit der Besprechung, dennoch fanden viele den Zeitpunkt ungünstig.
paragraphs.en: Everyone understood the necessity of the discussion, but many nevertheless found the timing inconvenient.

paragraphs.de: Die Vorbereitung des Themas hatte mehrere Tage gedauert.
paragraphs.en: The preparation of the topic had taken several days.

paragraphs.de: Je länger das Meeting dauerte, desto klarer wurde jedoch, wie wichtig es tatsächlich war.
paragraphs.en: The longer the meeting lasted, however, the clearer it became how important it actually was.

paragraphs.de: Am Ende waren fast alle froh, teilgenommen zu haben, obwohl sie anfangs skeptisch gewesen waren.
paragraphs.en: In the end, almost everyone was glad to have participated, although they had been skeptical at first.

questions.question: How did employees react to the meeting announcement?
What did many employees find inconvenient?
What became clearer as the meeting went on?
How did most people feel at the end?

lessons.title: A City Worth Visiting
lessons.titleNative: Eine Stadt, die einen Besuch wert ist
lessons.context: A descriptive travel text with participial attributes.

paragraphs.de: Die wachsende Stadt zieht jedes Jahr mehr Besucher an.
paragraphs.en: The growing city attracts more visitors every year.

paragraphs.de: Die restaurierten Gebäude im alten Zentrum erzählen von einer langen Geschichte.
paragraphs.en: The restored buildings in the old center tell of a long history.

paragraphs.de: Zwischen den blühenden Gärten findet man kleine Cafés mit lächelnden Kellnern.
paragraphs.en: Between the blooming gardens, you find small cafés with smiling waiters.

paragraphs.de: Die steigende Zahl an Touristen bringt der Stadt zwar Wohlstand, aber auch neue Herausforderungen.
paragraphs.en: The rising number of tourists brings the city prosperity, but also new challenges.

paragraphs.de: Um diesen Charme zu bewahren, ist es wichtig, das Wachstum sorgfältig zu planen.
paragraphs.en: In order to preserve this charm, it's important to plan the growth carefully.

questions.question: What does the city attract more of every year?
What do the restored buildings tell of?
What does the rising number of tourists bring?
What is important to preserve the city's charm?

lessons.title: What She Would Have Done Differently
lessons.context: A personal reflection using irreale Bedingungssätze and infinitive constructions.

paragraphs.de: Um erfolgreicher zu sein, hätte sie früher anfangen müssen, sagt sie heute.
paragraphs.en: In order to be more successful, she would have had to start earlier, she says today.

paragraphs.de: Anstatt so viel Zeit mit Zweifeln zu verbringen, hätte sie mutiger handeln sollen.
paragraphs.en: Instead of spending so much time doubting, she should have acted more bravely.

paragraphs.de: Wenn sie damals mehr Risiken eingegangen wäre, wäre sie vielleicht schon viel weiter.
paragraphs.en: If she had taken more risks back then, she might already be much further along.

paragraphs.de: Ohne diese Fehler zu machen, hätte sie jedoch vielleicht nie gelernt, was wirklich wichtig ist.
paragraphs.en: Without making these mistakes, however, she might have never learned what's really important.

paragraphs.de: Deshalb sieht sie ihre Vergangenheit heute mit gemischten, aber versöhnten Gefühlen.
paragraphs.en: That's why she looks at her past today with mixed, but reconciled feelings.

questions.question: What does she say she would have needed to do to be more successful?
What does she say she should have done instead of doubting?
What might she have never learned without making mistakes?
How does she see her past today?
options: She refuses to think about it

lessons.title: The Economics of Change
lessons.context: A more formal text with nominalization and consequence connectors.

paragraphs.de: Die Einführung neuer Technologien verändert häufig ganze Branchen.
paragraphs.en: The introduction of new technologies often changes entire industries.

paragraphs.de: Die Anpassung an diese Veränderungen ist für viele Unternehmen schwierig.
paragraphs.en: Adapting to these changes is difficult for many companies.

paragraphs.de: Je schneller sich der Markt verändert, desto wichtiger wird die Flexibilität eines Unternehmens.
paragraphs.en: The faster the market changes, the more important a company's flexibility becomes.

paragraphs.de: Unternehmen, die sich nicht anpassen, verlieren folglich oft ihre Wettbewerbsfähigkeit.
paragraphs.en: Companies that don't adapt consequently often lose their competitiveness.

paragraphs.de: Dennoch gibt es immer wieder Firmen, denen die Umstellung erstaunlich gut gelingt.
paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, there are always companies that succeed surprisingly well at the transition.

questions.question: What does the introduction of new technologies often do?
What becomes more important as markets change faster?
What happens to companies that don't adapt?
What does the passage say about some companies?
options: Some succeed surprisingly well at the transition

lessons.title: A Letter of Gratitude
lessons.context: A warm personal letter combining several B2 structures.

paragraphs.de: Liebe Freundin, ich schreibe dir, um dir für alles zu danken, was du für mich getan hast.
paragraphs.en: Dear friend, I'm writing to thank you for everything you've done for me.

paragraphs.de: Ohne deine Unterstützung zu haben, hätte ich diese schwierige Zeit nicht überstanden.
paragraphs.en: Without having your support, I wouldn't have survived this difficult time.

paragraphs.de: Du hast mir geholfen, ohne je etwas dafür zu erwarten, und das werde ich nie vergessen.
paragraphs.en: You helped me without ever expecting anything for it, and I will never forget that.

paragraphs.de: Wärst du nicht gewesen, wüsste ich nicht, wo ich heute stünde.
paragraphs.en: If it hadn't been for you, I wouldn't know where I would be standing today.

paragraphs.de: Deshalb wollte ich dir doch einfach mal sagen, wie dankbar ich bin.
paragraphs.en: That's why I just wanted to simply tell you how grateful I am.

questions.question: Why is the writer writing this letter?
What does the writer say about surviving the difficult time?
options: They wouldn't have survived without support

questions.question: What did the friend never expect?
What is the main point of the letter?

lessons.title: What Truly Matters
lessons.context: A capstone reflection combining B2's full grammar range.

paragraphs.de: Je älter ich werde, desto klarer wird mir, was im Leben wirklich zählt.
paragraphs.en: The older I get, the clearer it becomes to me what really matters in life.

paragraphs.de: Es sind nicht die großen Erfolge, sondern die kleinen, oft übersehenen Momente, die uns am meisten prägen.
paragraphs.en: It's not the big successes, but the small, often overlooked moments that shape us the most.

paragraphs.de: Zwar lässt sich Glück nicht erzwingen, aber man kann lernen, es dort zu erkennen, wo es sich zeigt.
paragraphs.en: Happiness can't be forced, but one can learn to recognize it where it shows itself.

paragraphs.de: Wenn ich doch nur früher verstanden hätte, wie wenig man eigentlich braucht, um zufrieden zu sein.
paragraphs.en: If only I had understood earlier how little one actually needs to be content.

paragraphs.de: Trotzdem bin ich dankbar, dass ich es überhaupt verstanden habe, denn manche Menschen lernen das nie.
paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, I am grateful that I understood it at all, because some people never learn that.

questions.question: What does the writer say really matters in life?
What does the writer say about happiness?
options: It can't be forced, but recognized where it shows itself

questions.question: What does the writer wish they had understood earlier?
options: How little one needs to be content

questions.question: How does the writer feel at the end?
